description: This file contains unit tests for the JpegSizeLimiter class, testing its ability to compress large payloads within size limits and to retain small payloads as-is.

classes.name: JpegSizeLimiterTest
classes.description: A test class with methods to verify the functionality of JPEG size limiting and compression logic.

methods.name: compressesLargePayloadsUnderLimit
methods.description: Tests that large images are compressed to stay under the specified byte limit.

methods.name: keepsSmallPayloadsAsIs
methods.description: Tests that small images are not compressed or altered.
